node.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one cubic collision-free value router
node.statement: For a collision-free cubic interpolant, the monic value resultant V_E=Res_W(L,X-E) is the product of the six used eighth-root colors. Multiplying by the quadratic for the missing pair gives V_E M_delta=X^8-1; cyclic translation reduces the 28 missing pairs to four distance packets delta=1,2,3,4.
node.notes: Exact p-free necessary router for collision-free cubic colors. No distance packet is declared empty and all assignment, norm, cyclotomic, and inner filters remain open.
